column4: Use your image generation tool. Generate a game prop concept image. SUBJECT: a standard industrial cargo crate, a 1.4 m cube, like the dark-grey crates with yellow end caps in the attached corridor concept: charcoal-grey composite panels with recessed ribs, chamfered yellow-painted metal corner caps and edge bands, a thin yellow-black hazard stripe trim, a small stencilled ID code (tiny, like 'C-07'). STYLE: match the attached concept images exactly (same game): a stylized 3D game asset render of a clean, bright sci-fi research facility prop. Palette from the references: dark charcoal-grey and light-grey painted metal, yellow and yellow-black hazard accents, navy/cobalt-blue trim, subtle wear and scuffs, crisp bevelled hard-surface shapes, readable chunky silhouette for a top-down mobile game. MESHY-READY RULES (this image feeds image-to-3D): exactly ONE object, centred, on a plain pure white background; three-quarter view from slightly above (about 25-30 degrees down), whole object in frame with a generous margin, nothing cropped; soft even studio lighting, NO cast shadow, NO floor, NO ground plane, NO other objects, NO people, NO aliens, NO text or letters except tiny stencil marks where asked. Square 1024x1024 PNG. When done, copy the final generated image into /Volumes/T7 Shield/Projects/Maze Swarm/Concepts/Crates/crate_cargo_crate.png (the image tool saves under ~/.codex/generated_images; find the newest file there, open it and confirm it is the image you just generated for THIS prompt before copying; if it breaks any rule above, generate again before copying). Reply with the path and the pixel dimensions.
